meta.name: Approximate decision · Euclidean
meta.metric: Parameterized time bound in n and gap factor γ
meta.regime: Euclidean GapSVP on arbitrary lattices; approximation factor γ is stated per result
meta.rules: For the factor γ stated by each entry, distinguish λ₁(L) ≤ r from λ₁(L) > γr, subject to the source theorem guarantee. This is promise decision, not approximate or exact vector search. Include preprocessing in total cost. Do not rank time bounds for different gap factors as one numerical leaderboard.
